dedupe_keys.name: priceportal open corpus of hospital price transparency machine readable files for california and indiana

description: PricePortal gathers the price lists that US hospitals must publish under federal price transparency rules and turns them into clean tables that can be compared across hospitals and with Medicare rates. The producers are Saptarshi Purkayastha, Parvati Naliyatthaliyazchayil and Deeksha Kayyari of Indiana University Indianapolis. Coverage is 528 Medicare-certified hospitals in California and Indiana: gross and cash prices for 478 hospitals, about 305 million rows, and insurer-specific negotiated rates for 411 hospitals, about 417 million rows, with a Medicare benchmark for about 9,700 procedure codes, price-to-Medicare ratios, state and payer summaries, and a crosswalk linking each hospital's federal, state, provider and tax identifiers. Indiana ZIP code demographics and health outcomes are added for equity analysis. The parquet files are available as a free download from Zenodo under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence, with code on GitHub and an online explorer. Caveats: hospitals publish files in inconsistent formats and not all comply, two states only, and the full tables are large. Simulation uses: representing the financial side of hospital systems, testing how price and payer mix affect where patients go, and the hospital identifier crosswalk for linking facility data sets. Related records: CMS hospital provider data (data-cms-provider-data-hospitals), HCRIS cost reports (data-cms-hcris-cost-reports) and California's HCAI utilisation and financial data (data-hcai-hospital-utilization-and-financial).
name: PricePortal: open corpus of hospital price transparency machine-readable files for California and Indiana

schema_summary: 16 parquet files (6.42 GB): gross and cash chargemaster prices (305 million rows, 478 hospitals); payer-specific negotiated rates (417 million rows, 411 hospitals); Medicare CPT/HCPCS benchmark (9,709 codes); hospital by code price-to-Medicare ratios; state and payer summaries; hospital identity crosswalk (CCN, OSHPD, NPI, EIN; 528 hospitals); Indiana ZIP demographics and CDC PLACES outcomes; data dictionary and SHA-256 manifest

temporal_coverage: Files as published by hospitals up to 2026; Medicare 2026 benchmarks
